units.hy: bp change, ICE BofA HY OAS
units.epu: change in 7-day avg log policy uncertainty x100

estimation: daily, 2022-01-03 to 2026-10-27 (1195 trading days), OLS with HAC(5) SEs; sector returns are daily log % returns of SPDR sector ETFs. File betas_2022_2025.csv holds these full-window betas (name kept for compatibility).
bonds: IGSB, IBID, AGZ, IAU: Bloomberg daily prices plus a yield carry for the bond funds (prices exclude distributions): IGSB = 3y Treasury + 0.7%, AGZ = 3y Treasury + 0.2%, IBID = 2y Treasury. IBID starts Sep 2023. VGIT, UST10 (long Treasuries), TIPS10: built from FRED yields with duration 4.6 / 8.5 / 8.7 plus carry and convexity. CASH earns the front fed funds futures rate.
